messages:
Maya: quick UX review — dashboard action row: primary button feels visually dominant next to the ghost when window width is small (320px). screenshot: https://img.redwood.dev/u/action-row.png
Leo: I noticed that too. probably padding + border contrast. try reducing primary horiz padding by 4px and slightly lowering font-weight.
Priya: also seeing toasts interrupting screen readers; currently all toasts announce assertive. propose mapping: error=assertive, info/success=polite. trim long toast copy for VO.
Design Bot: accessibility-check: toast aria-live currently 'assertive' for all. recommend intent-based aria-live. ghost text contrast ~3.9:1 at 12px, borderline. visual-regression: reducing primary padding causes 2px header shift on mobile (ok).
Maya: acceptance criteria: 1) primary not visually heavier than ghost at 320px, 2) toasts polite for non-errors, 3) VO previews trimmed to ~120 chars, 4) ghost contrast revalidated.
Leo: pushing small CSS vars to branch `design/actionrow-compact`: --btn-primary-padding-x:12px; --btn-primary-font-weight:500; --toast-vertical-space:10px.
Priya: I'll add a JS helper to trim toast readouts and mark long details aria-hidden with a link to expand.
Design Bot: reminder: update tokens.md and changelog for --btn-primary-padding-x and --toast-vertical-space.
Maya: thanks — schedule 10m sync tomorrow to confirm visuals and accessibility checks. :thumbsup:
